narrative: The technology sector is navigating significant shifts, with AI impacting job markets and data center infrastructure, while advancements in security and scientific research continue to push boundaries. Innovations range from enhanced mobile OS protections and running large language models on microcontrollers to breakthroughs in organ preservation and new space missions, highlighting a dynamic period of development and adaptation.

highlights.title: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
highlights.whyItMatters: AI advancements are leading to significant workforce restructuring across the tech industry, impacting numerous companies.

highlights.title: GrapheneOS protections against data extraction from locked devices
highlights.whyItMatters: New security measures in GrapheneOS offer enhanced protection against sophisticated data extraction techniques for mobile devices.

highlights.title: Running a 28.9M parameter LLM on an $8 microcontroller
highlights.whyItMatters: The capability to run large language models on low-cost microcontrollers opens new avenues for ubiquitous and edge AI applications.

highlights.title: One fallen power line exposed a growing AI data center problem. Here’s how to fix it.
highlights.whyItMatters: The increasing demand for AI data centers highlights critical infrastructure vulnerabilities and the need for more resilient power solutions.

highlights.title: The quest to keep organs alive outside the body
highlights.whyItMatters: Advances in preserving organs longer outside the body could revolutionize transplant medicine by increasing donor organ availability.

highlights.title: SpaceX eyes tower catch for next Starship after auspicious end to 13th flight
highlights.whyItMatters: SpaceX's ongoing Starship development, including ambitious recovery methods, continues to push the boundaries of space transportation technology.

highlights.title: Cloudflare Internal DNS is now generally available
highlights.whyItMatters: Cloudflare's new Internal DNS service offers a secure and global solution for managing private networks, enhancing enterprise infrastructure.
